frozen_selection.selection_method: sort eligible question IDs by SHA256(selection_salt:question_id), then take first 8

frozen_construction.target: official answer session rendered with the repository timestamped session document function
frozen_construction.hard_negative: non-answer session with maximum independent query-token overlap; hash breaks ties
frozen_construction.replacement: faithful local-model paraphrase of the target that preserves its facts and topic
frozen_construction.translation: for Japanese and Traditional Chinese strata, translate question, target, hard negative, and replacement together before evaluation

c0_intact_target_and_hard_negative.safe_outcome: select target or conservatively report ambiguous; never select hard negative

t2_replace_exact_target.safe_outcome: select replacement or conservatively report ambiguous; never select hard negative

fixed_scores.reason: Hold candidate score constant across all rows so only semantic support and intervention condition vary.

failure_rule: Reject if any hard negative is selected, if target removal selects any record, or if a required single-target condition cannot select its target.
inconclusive_rule: Any official-data hash, split, selection, construction-model, generation, language-count, implementation, or run-count drift makes the holdout inconclusive.
evidence_boundary: This holdout tests only whether lexical query support safely authorizes or rejects an explicit-memory planner bypass on official-derived unseen conversations.

pre_exposure_amendment.reason: Corrected a 63-character transcription typo to the already-fixed 64-character qwen2.5:7b digest after model preflight stopped, before the builder loaded or selected official rows.
